title: Tangkai Panjang Bikin TBS Kena Potong di Timbangan RAM
hook: Tandan matang belum tentu dibayar penuh kalau tangkainya masih panjang.
story: Pak Vincent memegang tandan sawit bertangkai panjang di tangan kiri dan dodos di tangan kanan sejak detik 0.0s. Ia bicara satu kalimat pendek soal tangkai panjang yang kena potong di timbangan RAM lalu memangkas tangkai itu dengan satu ayunan dodos dan mengangkat tandan rapi ke arah kamera. Situasi harian di kebun bukan kejadian baru dalam canon.
caption: Tandan sawit matang belum tentu dibayar penuh kalau tangkainya masih panjang. Di timbangan RAM tangkai ikut dihitung dan biasanya kena potong jadi lebih baik dirapikan dari kebun. Kawan-kawan biasa potong tangkai pakai dodos atau egrek? #sawitriau #tbs #timbanganram #kebunsawit #pekanbaru #petanisawit #panensawit
image_prompt: Pakai aset master terverifikasi Pak Vincent: pakvincent_three_expression_sheet.jpg (wajah) dan pakvincent_fullbody_turnaround.jpg (postur serta pakaian kebun). Tidak membuat master baru.

outfit.name: Vintage Blue Samsung Chelsea Jersey & Dark Shorts

shots.prompt: Authentic handheld smartphone vlog video of Pak Vincent the exact same Indonesian man shown in the two attached reference photos (three-expression sheet and full-body turnaround). Output exactly ONE man in ONE continuous shot never a collage split screen or reference-sheet layout. Vertical 9:16 10 seconds chest-height framing with slight natural handheld sway. Location: packed dirt yard in front of a small palm oil collection point in Riau with a wooden plank platform and stacked palm fruit bunches behind him under soft overcast late-afternoon light. He wears the vintage royal blue Samsung football jersey dark shorts dark baseball cap and rubber work sandals with lean wiry build sun-tanned weathered skin fine pores and smile lines and a thin mustache. PROP CONTINUITY: from 0.0s until the end of the clip he already holds one palm fruit bunch with a long uncut stalk in his left hand and one dodos chisel in his right hand and both objects stay in frame the whole time with nothing appearing or disappearing mid-take. At 0.0s he looks straight at the lens and lifts the bunch slightly so the long stalk is clearly visible then speaks one short sentence in natural Indonesian about a long stalk being trimmed at the weighbridge. Around the fifth second he lowers the bunch onto the plank and cuts the long stalk short with one firm dodos stroke. At the eighth second he raises the trimmed bunch toward the lens with a modest friendly smile and a small nod. Shot on a smartphone vlog camera neutral white balance 5500K true-to-life colors realistic matte human skin with visible fine pores no plastic shine no waxy or glass skin no yellow or orange tint no artificial golden glow zero CGI authentic documentary look. Clean frame with no baked-in text no subtitles no camera information bar no fps or color-temperature readout no location label no timestamps no watermark no logo and no extra people in focus.
